title: Windsurf vs Lovable: Code Editor or AI App Builder? (Honest 2026 Comparison)
summary: Windsurf is the best free AI code editor. Lovable is the best frontend-first app builder. But if you need a shipped full-stack product — database, auth, and deploy included — there's a third option most readers actually want.
body_markdown: Between February 3 and April 20, 2026, any authenticated Lovable user could access other users' public project chat histories and source code. The vulnerability went undetected for approximately 11 weeks. After public disclosure, Lovable patched it within two hours and made all historical public projects private by default. For teams building proprietary tools or handling sensitive data, this raised trust concerns.[Blink](https://blink.new/) handles project isolation with standard workspace permissions and auth controls — if security posture matters for your evaluation, it's worth reviewing what each platform's data handling looks like before committing.
